description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement SALLY FORTH (Solar Watch, WP-C46): at the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model; if that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent it from declaring a charge. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2); setup privileges: P1 detachment Solar Watch, the Shield-Captain given Sally Forth and standing next to Witchseeker Squad D, which advanced this turn (flags.advanced), CP 0 for both. The Charge phase starts (PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(9)): the start-of-phase window lists the free SALLY FORTH card with the Witchseekers marked '(advanced)'; a real click uses it; the charge panel then lists the Witchseekers among the units that can charge and Declare Charge against the Gretchin succeeds.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Solar Watch"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
var sc = GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"]
sc.meta["enhancements"] = ["Sally Forth"]
sc.models[0]["position"] = {"x": 1500.0, "y": 1700.0}
GameState.state.units["U_WITCHSEEKERS_D"].flags["advanced"] = true
GameState.state.units["U_WITCHSEEKERS_D"].flags["moved"] = true
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(9)
return true

steps.comment: the advanced Witchseekers are listed among the units that can charge
